## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://github.com/B1CA16/taskforge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#commit-messages)
- [ ] `ruff format .`, `ruff check .` and `pytest` pass locally
- [ ] Bug fixes include a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] Public functions and classes have docstrings ([code style](https://github.com/B1CA16/taskforge/blob/main/docs/contributing/code-style.md#docstrings))
- [ ] Docs updated ([writing docs](https://github.com/B1CA16/taskforge/blob/main/docs/contributing/writing-docs.md))
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` (skip for internal-only changes)
- [ ] Breaking changes are marked with `!` and explained
